text: 河岸沼泽迫使你们上坡。四人艰难地砍开荆棘和灌木前进。队伍经过斜坡边缘时，伯纳德拉住你的手肘。“教授，您看那边！”他说。
你从高处俯瞰，不禁倒吸一口气。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 553
text: Forced uphill by the sloughs along the riverside, the four of you laboriously hack through brambles and thicket. As your group passes close to the lip of a slope, Bernard catches your elbow. “Look there, Professor!” he says.
From your lofty perspective, you gaze down and gasp.
